text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheers envelop the victor.
<chrname> was not
at the center of that circle.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: —There is always a reason behind defeat.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"If you take another look at that,
the next result will definitely be different."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
You all can do it.
Without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spurred on by the two of them, I start running.
I need to scrutinize it right away: <chrname>'s running
for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!
